QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally, and nearly every library translation unit includes `common.h`, so inside the library `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to plain `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a shared header (common.h) turns the opt-out on for the library, so library translation units see plain member names.
